raw.query: SELECT ROUND(MIN(ratio_meas_over_aic)::numeric, 2) AS min_ratio, ROUND(MAX(ratio_meas_over_aic)::numeric, 2) AS max_ratio FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE engine = 'sdpa' AND is_valid = true AND source_path LIKE '%anchor_sdpa_5x50.json%' AND n_images >= 6 AND n_images <= 64;
raw.observed: Eager SDPA ratio_meas_over_aic ranges from 1.36x (at N=6, patches=4704) to 1.62x (at N=64, patches=50176); FlashAttention-2 ratio_meas_over_aic is 1.47x at N=64; torch.compile is 1.12x at N=64 (measured 355.91ms vs eager 511.21ms and composition 316.37ms)
raw.claimed: HuggingFace eager forward (SDPA) runs 1.36--1.62x above composition, rising with N; FlashAttention-2 recovers part leaving overhead intact; torch.compile closes most of the rest
raw.evidence: Eager SDPA overhead ratio over composition (AIC) goes from 1.36x to 1.62x rising with N; FlashAttention-2 at N=64 reduces this to 1.47x, and torch.compile (max-autotune) at N=64 reduces this to 1.12x, closing 80.2% of the eager overhead.
